overview: The Philippines is an island country in South-East Asia, made up of more than 7,000 islands in the western Pacific. Its capital is Manila, part of the huge Metro Manila area. The Philippines was a Spanish colony for more than 300 years and then an American territory, becoming independent in 1946. Filipino and English are its official languages, and most Filipinos are Christian.

geography.text: The islands fall into three main groups: Luzon in the north, the Visayas in the middle and Mindanao in the south. Most are mountainous and volcanic, with active volcanoes such as Mayon and Taal. The Philippines lies on the Pacific Ring of Fire and in the path of typhoons, and its seas have some of the richest coral reefs in the world.
